extName.description: The extension name, as shown in Chrome and on the Web Store.

extDescription.message: Password-encrypted bookmarks kept out of Chrome's bookmarks and omnibox. Opens in incognito. Optional sync via your own Google Drive.
extDescription.description: Store and toolbar description. Chrome truncates at 132 characters.

cmdAdd.message: Add the current tab to the vault
cmdAdd.description: Keyboard shortcut description, shown on chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

cmdLock.description: Keyboard shortcut description, shown on chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

cmdManager.description: Keyboard shortcut description, shown on chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

popupVersion.description: Build version shown in the popup header.

popupLoading.description: Shown for the moment before the service worker answers.

popupOpenManager.description: Link from the popup to the full manager page.

createIntro.message: Choose a master password. It encrypts everything you save, and it is never stored or sent anywhere.
createIntro.description: Introduction at the top of the create-vault form.

createFieldPassword.description: Label for the password field on the create-vault form.

createFieldConfirm.description: Label for the confirm-password field on the create-vault form.

createFieldPhrase.description: Label for the typed-confirmation field on the create-vault form.

createConfirmPhrase.description: The exact phrase the user must type to confirm there is no password recovery. Compared case-insensitively after trimming.

createNoRecoveryHeading.message: There is no way to recover this password.
createNoRecoveryHeading.description: Heading of the no-recovery warning on the create-vault form.

createNoRecoveryBody.message: No reset link, no recovery code, no support request. If you forget it, everything in the vault is gone for good — not even we can read it.
createNoRecoveryBody.description: Body of the no-recovery warning on the create-vault form.

createStrength.description: Password strength line under the meter.

createPasswordsDiffer.message: The two passwords do not match.
createPasswordsDiffer.description: Shown when the confirm field differs from the password field.

createWeakConfirm.message: That password is weaker than we would like, and it cannot be recovered later. Press the button again to use it anyway.
createWeakConfirm.description: Second confirmation shown when the chosen password scores below “good”.

createButton.description: Submit button on the create-vault form.

createButtonAnyway.description: Submit button after the weak-password warning has been shown.

createNeedsLength.message: Still needed: a password of at least $MINIMUM$ characters.
createNeedsLength.description: Shown under the disabled create button when the password is too short.

createNeedsMatch.message: Still needed: the two passwords have to match.
createNeedsMatch.description: Shown under the disabled create button when the confirmation differs.

createNeedsPhrase.message: Still needed: type “$PHRASE$” in the box above.
createNeedsPhrase.description: Shown under the disabled create button when the typed confirmation is missing.

warnTooShort.message: Too short — use at least 10 characters.
warnTooShort.description: Password warning: below the hard minimum length.

warnCommonPassword.message: This is one of the most commonly used passwords.
warnCommonPassword.description: Password warning: an exact match in the bundled common-password list.

warnCommonPasswordVariant.message: This is a common password with small substitutions — those are the first thing an attacker tries.
warnCommonPasswordVariant.description: Password warning: a leet or suffixed variant of a common password.

warnSingleCharacterClass.message: Only one kind of character. Mixing in others helps.
warnSingleCharacterClass.description: Password warning: all lowercase, all digits, and so on.

warnRepeatedCharacters.message: Contains a long run of repeated characters.

warnYearLike.message: Contains something that looks like a year.

unlockFieldPassword.description: Label for the password field on the unlock form.

unlockButton.description: Submit button on the unlock form.

lockedManual.description: Shown on the unlock screen after the user locked the vault.

lockedPanic.description: Shown on the unlock screen after a panic-lock.

lockedExpired.message: The vault locked itself after a period of inactivity.
lockedExpired.description: Shown on the unlock screen after the idle timeout expired.

lockedIdle.message: The vault locked itself because the computer went idle.
lockedIdle.description: Shown on the unlock screen after a system-idle lock.

lockedBlur.message: The vault locked itself when you switched away from Chrome.
lockedBlur.description: Shown on the unlock screen after a lock-on-blur lock.

unlockedHeading.description: Status line on the unlocked popup screen.

unlockedAutoLockIn.message: Locks itself after about $MINUTES$ min of inactivity.
unlockedAutoLockIn.description: Auto-lock countdown on the unlocked popup screen.

unlockedAutoLockNever.message: Stays unlocked until you lock it or close Chrome.
unlockedAutoLockNever.description: Shown instead of the countdown when the idle timeout is set to Never.

unlockedLockButton.description: Button that locks the vault from the popup.

settingsIdleNever.description: The idle-timeout choice that disables auto-locking.

settingsLockOnBlur.message: Lock when I switch to another app
settingsLockOnBlur.description: Label for the lock-on-browser-blur toggle. Must not read as 'when Chrome closes' — it fires on focus loss, which is a very different promise.

settingsLockOnBlurHint.message: Locks the moment Chrome loses focus, so you re-enter your password on every switch back. Moving between Chrome windows does not lock.

errorWrongPassword.description: Error shown when the master password fails to unwrap the data key.

errorPasswordTooShort.message: A master password needs at least $MINIMUM$ characters.
errorPasswordTooShort.description: Error shown when the password is below the hard minimum length.

errorCorruptVault.message: The vault data on this device is damaged. Restore a backup to recover it.
errorCorruptVault.description: Error shown when authenticated decryption fails.

errorUnsupportedSchema.message: This vault was made by a newer version of VaultaMark. Update the extension to open it.
errorUnsupportedSchema.description: Error shown when the vault schema version is newer than this build supports.

errorVaultLocked.description: Error shown when an operation needed an unlocked vault.

errorVaultState.message: That does not match the state of the vault on this device.
errorVaultState.description: Error shown when creating a vault that exists, or unlocking one that does not.

errorUnreachable.message: The background service is not responding. Try reopening this window.
errorUnreachable.description: Error shown when the service worker did not answer at all.

errorUnknown.description: Error shown for anything not covered by a more specific message.

managerPlaceholder.message: The vault lives here. Nothing to show yet — the manager arrives in the next phase.
managerPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text on the manager page before the vault UI exists.
